environment.gpu: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090 via ANGLE Direct3D11
environment.models: Actual V3 Iron Vanguard: local player plus seven AI

method: Independent live High/Low matches with normal AI, stationary first-person camera, 2s warmup plus 15s requestAnimationFrame interval sampling. Build/typecheck stopped before retained samples. Normal combat and round transitions were allowed; Low ended during a round countdown. Runs are not seeded or directly comparable across quality tiers. Counters include rendered passes/shadows.

earlierHighBeforeBeamCleanup.note: Separate nondeterministic match; not evidence of a measured optimization delta.

traversal.automated: Actual production horizontal movement, vertical integration, and boundary clamp: exactly 8s width / 15s length, both directions at 30/60/144Hz.
traversal.liveMethod: Real W+Shift input in the actual loaded map. Set sandbox rules during timing, parked other actors away from the path, prevented player damage/ball carrying. No movement or collision implementation overridden. performance.now timer begins immediately after keydown and ends at boundary; browser scheduling introduces approximately one frame of uncertainty.

checks.relatedLayoutReplayNavigationTests: 82 passed in resize workstream; overlapping coverage is not added to the stadium total
checks.legacyReplayGeometry: Original 104 x 46 retained for unversioned/revision1 recordings in playback, loading previews, and heatmaps
checks.visualReview: Floor albedo remains quiet; shallow joints/roughness add detail through highlights. Wall cassettes, louvers, kickplates and trim supply stronger detail outside the court. Soft High beams fade above floor, removing hard cone silhouettes.

limitations: Short high-end GPU samples do not certify 60 FPS on slower GPUs or at higher resolutions.
Online premade maps still synchronize by map ID; all peers must use the updated build for the resized layout. Mixed old/new build geometry negotiation is not implemented.
Failed test-harness runs interrupted by development-page reloads were discarded and rerun after build completion.
Fallback loading and resource teardown coverage remain in test:stadium; the first-pass blocked-download browser capture is recorded separately in qa-report-2026-10-16.json.
